$comment: Wrong-word patterns for check.mjs (code wrong-word). Each pattern fires when the target locale's language is in `locales`, the English matches `source` (if given), and the translation matches `target`. `short` limits it to button-like strings (2 words or fewer, no sentence punctuation). `fileMix` patterns fire when two forms are used in one catalog. Suggestions marked draft are not source-attested.

patterns.message: A subscription or renewal string uses the dialog Cancel word, which reads as "close this dialog". Say what stops: the renewal, or that it ends at the period.

suggest.ms: Akan dibatalkan pada akhir tempoh / Hentikan pembaharuan automatik (draft)

patterns.message: تحميل is read as upload or loading. Download is تنزيل.
过滤器 is a physical or technical filter. UI filtering is 筛选 (Simplified) or 篩選 (Traditional).
காப்பிடு means copy. The archive verb is காப்பகப்படுத்து (draft).
अभी नहीं means "not now". It is neither skip nor deny.
A button is an infinitive (Speichern), not a command with Sie (Speichern Sie).

patterns.target: (?:します|してください|しましょう)[。]?$
patterns.message: A Japanese button is a noun or dictionary form (保存), not a polite sentence (保存します).

suggest.ja: drop します / してください

patterns.message: One string uses both 您 and 你. Pick one form for the whole product.

suggest.zh: 您 or 你, as the rest of the file

patterns.message: Indonesian word in a Malay file. (Daftar is fine in both languages.)

suggest.ms: Muat turun / Padam / Kata laluan / Muat naik

patterns.message: தெளிவு is the noun "clarity". Clear (empty a field or filters) is the verb அழி.
"Sesuatu telah berlaku" means "something has happened"; the error is lost.
Ống kính is a camera lens. An API or OAuth scope is phạm vi (draft).
Sales "lead" (a potential customer) was translated as the metal, the verb "to lead", "tracks" or "clue".
إلغاء is the dialog Cancel word. Revoking a token or access reads better as إبطال or سحب.
A date follows this label. "Memperbarui" is "renewing" with no "on".

fileMix.message: The file mixes du and Sie. Use one form everywhere.
The file mixes 您 and 你. Use one form everywhere.
